chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿUthmān al-Aʿwar, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Walīd—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from Fuḍayl ibn ʿUthmān al-Aʿwar al-Murādī al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: a major transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الْأَعْوَرِ: the named transmitter whose chain is being clarified
key_terms.الْمُرَادِيِّ الْكُوفِيِّ: tribal and geographical identifiers for the narrator
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial attribution of transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿUthmān al-Aʿwar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿUthmān al-Aʿwar. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is central to hadith preservation and evaluation in Shia hadith scholarship.
